title: Deeper/broader FreeCAD 2D boundary and SAT/SAB peer-route review
mode: public-source research only; no peer installation, build, or execution

sources.observation: DWG wrapper converts through an external converter to temporary DXF and then invokes the DXF import route; converter choice is installation/configuration-dependent.
DWG support depends on external converters; documentation distinguishes the 2D DXF route from the CADExchanger 3D DWG workflow.
FreeCAD documents separate C++ and legacy Python DXF import/export backends with different feature coverage.
FreeCAD's current file-format guidance says its DXF and DWG paths support only 2D geometry.
A FreeCAD maintainer confirms in the issue response that ACIS blobs in DXF solids are not read by the stock FreeCAD DXF route.
Autodesk 3DSOLID groups include modeler version 70, repeated proprietary payload groups 1/3, and optional history reference 350.
Autodesk warns not to assume entity group-code order is fixed.

The separately implemented read-only codec accepts bare SAT/SMT/SAB/SMB streams, exposes model-transfer losses, and identifies verified binary ACIS save formats 217/218; other ACIS bands are unverified/recovery-labelled. The current published codec is 0.6.1 and requires Rust 1.88 or later.
The project rates bare ASM/ACIS streams L1; the published level is not a general B-rep semantic or native acceptance claim.
The project publishes a clean-room policy based on legally possessed files and public documentation, excluding vendor SDKs, decompiled binaries, and confidential knowledge.
Current source recognizes AcDb:AcDsPrototype_1b and dispatches a dedicated AcDs parser path.
Published NEWS still describes modern R2013+ SAB extraction from AcDs as not fully reliable and partly brute-force.

findings.result: Stock DWG conversion plus DXF import is a 2D route; successful conversion/import does not exercise ACIS solid semantics.
3DSOLID carrier integrity must compare ordered group 1/3 payload bytes, group 70, optional group 350, and the enclosing object/owner graph; legal group order cannot be assumed globally.

cadmpeg-codec-sat is an optional bare-stream decoder/model comparator with a narrow documented profile; it does not parse DWG AcDs and does not establish general B-rep validity or native CAD acceptance.
